text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Splendid. Your archery is as magnificent 
as ever— 
though haven't you grown even sharper of 
late?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I am honored. That said, I haven't 
had 
much time to practice of late.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oho. Then could it be what's within— 
that your mind and spirit have grown?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...My spirit, is it? If that is the 
case...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—Hm. Next week focuses mainly on explosive 
power, I see. 
A splendid routine as always. Above all—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I am grateful that you incorporated 
stretching exercises 
for the mornings when my body doesn't move 
well. 
...I am always in your debt.
choice_data_list:
It's the least I could do. It's for your 
sake.

It's only natural. It's for you, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
choice_data_list: これくらいは当然。君のためだ
これくらいは当然。貴方のためだし
choice_data_list_en: It's the least I can do. It's for your sake.
It's the least I can do. After all, it's for you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
And yet—you seem to be hesitating over 
something?
choice_data_list:
Seeing how good you're feeling today, I 
thought we could add another set...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
choice_data_list: 今日の調子なら1セット追加もありかと……
choice_data_list_en: Given how you're feeling today, maybe we could add one more set...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Nonsense. If you feel it can be done, 
then it shall be done. Heh... that is how 
it goes.
choice_data_list: あ、いや、無理はしなくていいんだけど――
choice_data_list_en: Ah, no, you don't have to push yourself, though—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—Indeed. Lately, my heart has been clear 
and unburdened. It is only natural my 
arrows find their mark.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oho. So you have found yourself a 
dependable pillar of support, then.
